name: The Open Mind
gloss: Minds read, minds taught, minds joined. The scholar's route: it makes a university faster than any other line in the grid, and it makes every thought in that university legible to anyone who walks it.

excludes.gloss: Opening a mind and shutting one are the same act run backwards. Intellego Mentem is a filter opening onto a reverbless tone; Perdo Mentem is a hole taken out of that same tone. Opposed in kind, so the exclusion runs both ways.

name: The Sealed Mind
gloss: Thought made unreadable and then made absent. The warden's route: nothing on it teaches faster, and nothing else in the grid keeps a secret at all.

name: The Quarried World
gloss: Stone found, stone lifted, stone set. The builder's route, and the only sustained source of universe-scale yield in the v1 grid.

excludes.gloss: Raising stone and collapsing it are one skill practised in opposite directions. A mason who has learned where a seam gives way cannot unlearn it, and will not trust the course she lays on it. Opposed in kind, so it runs both ways.

name: The Hollow Ground
gloss: Ground opened, arches pulled down, halls swallowed. The sapper's route: the deepest area denial in the grid, bought by giving up the ability to build.

name: The Standing Gate
gloss: Thresholds counted, held, sealed, and finally opened. The portal-wright's route, and the only way to a gate that stands without being held.

excludes.gloss: A gate is a name for a place, kept. The nameless road is the practice of taking names away. One mind cannot hold both doctrines and still find its own doors. Opposed in kind, so it runs both ways.

name: The Nameless Road
gloss: Names heard, names taken, names unsaid. The thief's route: every knowledge-steal above the shallowest is on it, and so is the only real concealment in the grid.

name: The Unwritten
gloss: What is left when a scholar has refused both the open mind and the quarried world. The deepest nodes in the v1 grid sit here, and they are reachable only by a mage who has declined the two lines every other mage takes first.

excludes.gloss: The unwritten is what a mind holds that it has never made legible. A scholar who has given one lesson from an open mind has written it down in someone. Opposed in kind, so it runs both ways.
A scholar who has cut one stone has written on the world. The unwritten is the practice of having left it alone. Opposed in kind, so it runs both ways.
